title: Clear
plainLanguageDefinition: The problem and response are known.
whatToAvoid: Do not overcomplicate simple safety guidance.

title: Complicated
whatToDo: Consult specialists, compare evidence, and review constraints.
whatToAvoid: Do not pretend a quick scan is enough.

title: Complex
plainLanguageDefinition: Many variables interact and outcomes are not fully predictable.
whatToDo: Probe, learn, adapt, and watch feedback.
example: Social cohesion, youth leadership, long-term recovery.

title: Chaotic
plainLanguageDefinition: Immediate harm or instability is present.
whatToDo: Prioritize safety, stabilization, and verified information.
whatToAvoid: Do not amplify rumors or improvise field action.

title: Uncertain / disordered
plainLanguageDefinition: There is not enough clarity yet.
whatToDo: Pause, gather evidence, and avoid overclaiming.
whatToAvoid: Do not turn unreviewed reports into conclusions.
